Every config/ui/*.json bundle, config/access/ui.json, config/access/messages.json, config/goal-navigation.json and config/workspace-preferences.json carries each listed language with the same keys. review: 'human' when a person wrote or read the wording, 'machine' when it is a machine translation nobody has read yet; a machine-translated language shows a notice saying so. locale formats dates and numbers.
